name: BridgeData V2: A Dataset for Robot Learning at Scale
description: BridgeData V2 is a large-scale, multi-environment robotic manipulation dataset consisting of exactly 53,896 demonstration trajectories (over 60,000 total demonstrations including teleoperation trials) collected across 24 distinct tabletop environments. Developed by researchers at UC Berkeley to study cross-environment generalization, reusable visual representations, and language-conditioned manipulation, BridgeData V2 provides synchronized multi-camera RGB video, proprioceptive arm telemetry, gripper states, and natural language task annotations collected on low-cost WidowX 250 robot arms. It represents a major constituent of modern Vision-Language-Action pretraining corpuses including RT-X and Octo.
